agent_data_note: Use mounted baseline fuzzers at `dataset_candidate/dbms-differential-testing-tools/` (SQLancer, SQLsmith, SQUIRREL). Build MySQL, MariaDB, and Percona with AFL++ instrumentation. Implement or restore THANOS storage-engine rotation differential testing per the paper protocol.
benchmark_rules: Test targets: MySQL 8.0.x, MariaDB 10.x, Percona Server 8.0.x — each with multiple storage engines (InnoDB, MyISAM, Memory, etc.).
Baselines: SQLancer, SQLsmith, SQUIRREL — build and configure uniformly per upstream docs.
Primary metrics: (1) branch coverage via AFL++ on instrumented DBMS binaries; (2) confirmed distinct bugs in 24h runs.
Paper protocol: 3 DBMSs × 4 tools (THANOS + 3 baselines) × 24 hours each; compare query-result, error-message, and final-state oracles.
THANOS rotates storage engines and synthesizes feature-oriented equivalent test cases; equivalence feature lists are part of the tool/paper artifact.
Use ODBC or unified client interface to schedule SQL against equivalent engine configurations.
Shared mount is read-only. Write DBMS build trees, server data dirs, fuzz output, and metrics under `project/` or `results/`.
If official THANOS repo is unavailable, implement the four-step pipeline from the paper (engine selection → equivalence extraction → feature-oriented synthesis → differential comparison).
Deduplicate bugs (minimized test case + config + output signature).
non_goals: Using a single default storage engine only (paper requires engine rotation)
Skipping AFL++ instrumentation when reporting branch coverage
Substituting logic-bug-only SQLancer runs without crash/oracle differential testing for THANOS comparison
